name: Grand Marché Dabanani
subtitle: Dabanani is the part of Bamako's Grand Marché that has burned repeatedly.

facts.label: Fires
facts.value: Described in 2024 as burning almost every year at Dabanani

facts.label: 14 February 2024
facts.value: A fire broke out around 2 a.m. at Dabanani

facts.label: 2017 fire
facts.value: The December 2017 fire of the 'marché rose' was its third, after 1993 and 2014, and the most serious

facts.label: Access
facts.value: Narrow alleys make it hard for firefighters to reach the market

parts.text: Dabanani is the part of Bamako's Grand Marché that has burned repeatedly. Press reports describe frequent fires and narrow alleys that hamper firefighters.
